subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhangra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhangra is a lively form of folk music and dance that originates from Punjab.**
 
• ***It is not considered a classical dance form in India.***
 
• It is traditionally associated with the **harvest festival of Baisakhi and is characterized by the beat of the dhol, a double-sided drum.**
 
• The dance is known for its **high energy levels, vibrant movements, and rhythmic beats.**
 
• While Bhangra has its roots in** traditional Indian culture, it has also evolved significantly in the modern age, influenced by other music genres and cultures.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
